description.value:
This runic pillar is integrated into your armor in a convenient location. The spell refactoring matrix within captures wasted magical particles, keeping them charged for another volley.

Activate—Refactor Magicule r

Frequency once per day

Trigger You Cast a heightened spell from a spell slot, and you failed or critically failed all spell attack rolls or all affected creatures critically succeeded at their saving throws against the spell

Effect The matrix captures a portion of the wasted spell. You can cast the same spell again at two ranks lower than the rank you originally cast it, without using a spell slot. If the spell can't be cast at that rank or you don't cast the spell before the end of your next turn, the captured spell is wasted.
